headline: Central Frontline Erupts as Furious Base Swaps Rattle Key Sectors
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, ferocious attritional battles and frequent strongpoint exchanges have intensified along the central line, spearheaded by relentless combat in Linn of Mercy, Weathered Expanse, and Palantine Berm. Linn of Mercy registered four fresh base transitions and endured over thirty-four hundred casualties in the last two hours alone as Outwich Ranch and Lathair faced ongoing destruction. In Weathered Expanse, severe fighting around Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch generated three further turnovers alongside thirty-five hundred recent casualties, leaving multiple redoubts leveled in no-man's-land. Palantine Berm continued its volatile seesaw with three additional base shifts centering on Vendett and Windburn Landing. To the northwest, Stonecradle reignited with two rapid transitions at Trammel Pool and The Dais, while Marban Hollow logged another exchange at Checkpoint Bua. Although base ownership on the Nevish Line held steady over the past two hours, combat there accelerated drastically with nearly fifteen hundred casualties reported. Meanwhile, Mooring County, Kuura Strand, and rear territorial sectors have lapsed into comparative quiet.
